calendar.instructions: To do what the owner asks, must the assistant read or change the owner's own calendar: their events, classes, lectures, exams, meetings, appointments, free or busy time, invites, what is next or what their day or week holds? Yes too when the request points at one of their events by its time or name ("my 3pm", "my next class") and needs when or where it is, or when the request asks to put something on their calendar. No for general questions about dates or how calendars work.

maps.instructions: To do what the owner asks, must the assistant look up places or getting around: a place's address or map link, directions, travel time, the route, traffic, places nearby to go to, or the weather or forecast somewhere? No for a business's opening hours, news, or general facts.

gmail.instructions: To do what the owner asks, must the assistant read the owner's own email: find, read, count or summarize messages in their inbox, what someone emailed or sent them, or a receipt, code, link or confirmation that came by email? No when the request only sends something, and no for whether an email service is working.

drive.instructions: To do what the owner asks, must the assistant find, open, read or create a document, spreadsheet, slide deck or PDF stored in the owner's cloud drive, or save something there? No for a file only on the computer's desktop or downloads folder.

github.instructions: To do what the owner asks, must the assistant read or change the owner's code projects on GitHub: repositories, issues, pull requests, commits, branches, or build and CI status? No for general programming questions or advice.

doordash.instructions: To do what the owner asks, must the assistant order food, groceries or other items for delivery or pickup, or look at such orders: what is open to order, a menu, the cart, placing, reordering or tracking an order, or past delivery orders and their cost? No for questions about a delivery company as a business, or for finding a place to go and eat in person.

share.instructions: To do what the owner asks, must the assistant send a file (a document, deck, PDF, photo, screenshot or other file) to another person by text message or email? No when the file goes to the owner themself, and no for a plain message with no file.

workspace.instructions: To do what the owner asks, must the assistant read or write in the owner's Slack, Notion or Linear: messages, channels, mentions, threads, pages, tickets or sprints? No for opening one of those apps on the computer screen, or for comparing such products.
